entry.title: Kristen Bell & Adam Brody on Why Joanne & Noah Work in 'Nobody Wants This' | Portrait Mode | BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Kristen Bell & Adam Brody on Why Joanne & Noah Work in 'Nobody Wants This' | Portrait Mode | BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Kristen Bell and Adam Brody might not rate their painting skills very highly, but they don’t think that really matters as long as they’re enjoying the process. In this episode of “Portrait Mode,” the ‘Nobody Wants This’ stars attempt to create paintings worthy of the Met while reflecting on what they’ve learned from working together, from the qualities they admire in each other to what Joanne and Noah have taught them personally. They also debate whether their characters are actually in a healthy relationship, reveal how much their morning routines depend on their children, and share the hills they’d die on.
Stream ‘Nobody Wants This’ on Netflix.

entry.title: Jordyn Woods-Towns on Her Wedding Looks, Knicks Win & Fine Art Collection | The Good Buy | BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Jordyn Woods-Towns on Her Wedding Looks, Knicks Win & Fine Art Collection | The Good Buy | BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Jordyn Woods-Towns knows how to make a statement. In this episode of “The Good Buy,” the model-turned-entrepreneur sits down with Harper’s BAZAAR to unpack her approach to shopping, from building her collection of high/low staples to hunting down rare accessories that feel more like fine art than fashion. Watch as Jordyn breaks down the Knicks courtside looks that made her go viral (including that “lucky” orange bag), talks through the inspiration behind her brand, Woods by Jordyn, and gives us an inside look at the design process behind her three bespoke wedding gowns. She also shares the first luxury purchase she ever made, explains why she never regrets a look, and reveals the rare watch she dreams of adding to her collection.

entry.title: Natalie Portman Revisits Her Most Iconic Fashion Moments | Fashion Flashback | Harper’s BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Natalie Portman Revisits Her Most Iconic Fashion Moments | Fashion Flashback | Harper’s BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Natalie Portman has spent decades making memorable fashion moments on and off the red carpet. In this episode of “Fashion Flashback,” the Academy Award-winning actress and Harper’s BAZAAR cover star looks back at some of her most iconic looks, from the Betsey Johnson dress and faux-fur jacket she wore to the ‘Léon’ premiere at 13 to the Lanvin gown Albert Elbaz made for her first Oscars. She also reflects on her most memorable Golden Globes and Cannes looks, the dresses she’s been able to keep from her red carpet archive, and the challenges of wearing couture on the red carpet.
Read Natalie Portman’s Harper’s BAZAAR cover story here: http://harpersbazaar.com/natalie-portman-november-2026
